sources.label: Hiosdra
sources.author: Hiosdra
patch_list: F1 TV - Background playback
Keeps Bitmovin playback alive and enables Tiledmedia background audio for F1 TV multiview.
F1 TV - Change package name
Changes the F1 TV package name to allow installing a separate patched instance. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name.
F1 TV - Disable Play Store updates
Disables Play Store updates for the F1 TV package by setting its version code to the maximum allowed.
F1 TV - Dismiss forced update prompt
Allows closing F1 TV's forced-update dialog without exiting the app.
F1 TV - Foreground playback service
Keeps background F1 TV playback alive with an Android media playback notification and playback/PiP controls.
F1 TV - Picture-in-Picture
Keeps F1 TV playback alive while entering Android Picture-in-Picture mode.

sources.label: Morphe patch bundle for F1 TV (Android TV) to unlock 4K UHD streaming
sources.author: F1TV 4K
patch_list: Adaptive Playback Decoder Hints
Sets max-width and max-height hints on the secure HEVC decoder to prevent TM4014 allocation crashes on MediaTek / Amlogic chipsets during resolution ramp-up.
Dynamic HDR / Colorspace Routing
Routes HLG HDR streams per device at runtime: native HLG for supported TVs, PQ reroute for NVIDIA Shield, and direct rendering for MediaTek/Amlogic TVs.
Enable Video Quality Selector
Enables the in-app manual video quality (resolution / bitrate) selector in the playback options menu.
Unlock UHD / 4K Playback
Enables 2160p (4K UHD) streaming by bypassing device whitelist checks, display resolution limits, and HDR capability gates.
